sourceDeclaration.meaning: Read from the existing declaration; this review does not independently establish full-tree source equality.

method: Bounded read-only comparison of the accepted scope, current framework/adapters, focused test cases, and evidence index. No tests, browser sessions, heavy replays, or Git mutations were performed.
result: No additional material runtime or acceptance blocker identified within this review scope.

reviewedInvariants.invariant: Balanced mode and level/variant rotation without extra weight for duplicate recordings; unavailable and corrupt sources cannot starve healthy entries.
reviewedInvariants.limit: Normal bag cycles avoid adjacent repeats; bounded recovery may reuse a previously verified performance.

reviewedInvariants.invariant: Total recovery deadline includes alternate candidates; cancelled or late results are retired; prefetch does not create a second scene.
Scene retirement independently attempts owned cleanup, retains cross-close ordering, and discards accumulated settled results.
A shared scheduler bounds hidden playback, rebases freeze/resume, respects explicit pause, and preserves ordinary state.
reviewedInvariants.limit: Unit lifecycle coverage is not proof of actual browser discard. Solo navigation/BFCache pause policy is distinct from freeze/resume playback intent.

reviewedInvariants.invariant: Fresh input enters isolated practice; shared settings are read-only until an explicit change, with no boot migration writes.
reviewedInvariants.limit: Physical controller/radio and real mobile behavior remain device review gates.

observations: Browser-specific recordings are not counted as additional required levels.
Full native/browser replay proofs are distinguished from representative interaction and exact-tick samples.
Historical, partial, and strict-failed receipts retain their source and outcome limitations.
No new final acceptance credit is created by this read-only review.

documentationFollowUp.status: Verified corrected wording in the working tree after parent edit.
documentationFollowUp.meaning: Eligible launches arrive at Ready; installed locked Solo missions enter isolated practice and uninstalled missions open the ordinary chooser. This documentation edit is not represented as part of the reviewed HEAD.

outstandingGatesUnchanged: Final emitted packaging and frozen-source browser refresh retain their own pending/running status and receipts.
Strict WebKit navigation diagnostics, including the unclassified historical Context is stopped event, remain explicitly tracked.
An uninterrupted two-hour final-source rotation remains required; interrupted earlier runs provide no duration credit.
Hosted CI and physical-controller/radio, real mobile, audible-output, and unfamiliar-player review remain separate gates.
